$comment: Validator waivers. Same discipline FR-MKTS-14 applies to a market readiness item: a recorded owner, a reason, and an expiry after which the failure is fatal again. A waived failure is still printed on every run — this file suppresses the exit code, never the finding.

waivers.reason: Genuine WCAG 1.4.11 failure introduced by the 2026-09-05 accent decision and never re-measured: accent.css overrides --commerce-rating to signal orange, but guidelines/contrast-report.md still measures the pre-accent near-black (13.36:1). Actual: 2.24:1 light, 2.84:1 dark. Needs a design decision, not a token nudge — darkening the empty star to the required oklch(0.38) would make it read as a filled dark star. See docs/adr/0009-rating-contrast.md. void-placeholder inherits the same pairing by derivation (removing chroma preserves lightness, and lightness is what contrast depends on), so this waiver is not scoped to one set.
